# Error

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

A snapshot of the last PPL 400 operation result, including subsystem, error code, message and optional channel.

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#errors).

## Channel

`Error.Channel: INTEGER`

Read-only instance property.

Related audio/media channel, or `-1` when the result is not channel-specific.

## Clear

```PPL
Error.Clear() BOOLEAN
```

Static function.

Clears the stored error and returns `TRUE`.

## Code

`Error.Code: ErrCode`

Read-only instance property.

Machine-readable result category such as invalid input, unavailable capability, I/O failure, limit or timeout.

## Kind

`Error.Kind: ErrKind`

Read-only instance property.

Subsystem that produced the result, such as file, graphics, font, audio, terminal, message, network, user, string or regex.

## Last

```PPL
Error.Last() Error
```

Static function.

Returns a stable copy of the most recently published PPL 400 operation result.

## Message

`Error.Message: STRING`

Read-only instance property.

Human-readable diagnostic detail. Programs should branch on `Kind` and `Code`, not translated prose.

## OK

`Error.OK: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

Whether `Code` equals `ErrCode.Ok`.
